name: Gunavatta Evam Navaachar Nishulk Paathy Pustak Yojana
benefit: Every year, in accordance with the guidelines of the Directorate of Elementary and Secondary Education, free textbooks are provided to all students from Classes 1 to 8 in government schools, government-aided schools, and recognized madrasas following the state government curriculum.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a student from Classes 1 to 8. 1. The applicant must be studying in a government or government-aided school, or a recognized madrasa that follows the Uttarakhand state government curriculum.
